title: UI layout tweak, admin deletion fixes, admin login log display, and in-app toast notifications

requirements.summary: Render Win and Loss controls side-by-side (horizontal) across mobile and desktop while preserving existing styling.
acceptanceCriteria: On the affected screen(s), the Win and Loss labels/values appear horizontally next to each other (not vertically stacked) on common breakpoints (mobile and desktop).
No overlapping/truncation occurs; spacing remains visually consistent with the rest of the UI.

file_operations.description: Update the Win/Loss control layout classes so the Win and Loss sections render side-by-side on the same row even on mobile, preserving existing spacing/typography and preventing overlap/truncation.

requirements.summary: Fix Admin delete actions for users and user-day availability so deletions execute immediately with valid Principals and the UI refreshes without manual reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the delete button for a user removes that user from the Registered Users table after the mutation completes.
Clicking the delete button for an availability removes that availability row from the All Availabilities table after the mutation completes.
After deleting a user, the All Availabilities table also updates (since the backend deletes that user’s availabilities).
Deletion uses valid Principal objects (no unsafe casts) so the backend calls succeed.

file_operations.description: Replace unsafe Principal casting in delete handlers with constructing valid Principal objects (e.g., from text) for both delete user and delete availability actions, and ensure local deleting-state handling still works.

Ensure admin delete mutations invalidate all relevant react-query caches so the Admin UI updates immediately (including invalidating All Availabilities after deleting a user, and keeping existing invalidations for availability deletions).

requirements.summary: Show an admin-only per-user latest sign-in timestamp in the Admin tab, using existing readable date/time formatting utilities.
acceptanceCriteria: On login, the app records the caller’s latest login timestamp (one per user, overwriting the prior value is acceptable).
Admins can view a list/table in the Admin page showing users and their latest login timestamp formatted in a human-readable way (e.g., using the existing date formatting utilities).
Non-admin users cannot access the login timestamp list (backend enforces admin access; frontend does not show it).

file_operations.description: Add a react-query hook to fetch admin login timestamps (using the existing backend capability) so the Admin page can display latest sign-in times.

Display each user’s latest sign-in timestamp in the Admin Panel (admin-only view already enforced by AccessDeniedScreen). Format timestamps via existing date utilities and handle missing timestamps gracefully (e.g., show '—').

requirements.summary: Add in-app toast notifications for new availability added by other users (Calendar/Day Detail) and for positive caller rank changes on the Leaderboard, using polling/refetch without spamming.
acceptanceCriteria: Availability notification: while a signed-in user is viewing the Calendar and/or Day Detail views, the UI detects new availability added by a different principal and shows a toast notification.
Leaderboard notification: while a signed-in user is on the Leaderboard tab, the UI detects when the caller’s rank position improves (any positive change) and shows a toast notification.
Notifications are implemented as small toast pop-ups (per existing toast usage) and do not require push notifications.
Notification logic does not spam: repeated polling/refetching without changes does not re-trigger the same toast.

file_operations.description: Create reusable notification logic (poll/refetch + diffing with refs) for: (1) availability changes by other principals while on Calendar/Day Detail, and (2) caller rank improvement while on Leaderboard. Use the existing toast system (sonner) and ensure notifications only fire on detected state transitions (no repeat-toasts on identical data).
Wire the new in-app notification hook into the Calendar view to poll/refetch availability signals and show a toast when a different principal adds availability (without spamming).
Wire the new in-app notification hook into the Day Detail view to poll/refetch the day availability list and show a toast when a different principal appears in the list (without spamming).

Wire the new in-app notification hook into the Leaderboard view to poll/refetch leaderboard data while the tab is active and show a toast when the caller’s rank improves compared to the previous observed rank (without spamming).

Add minimal support needed for notification polling/refetch (e.g., optional query polling/refetch configuration or helper accessors) without changing immutable hook entrypoints; keep existing behavior unchanged for other callers.
